title: A store's headcount counts once, however many sales it has
question: What is the sales amount per employee?
behavior: store_productivity has a component on store_sales and one on store, each in its own branch: 415 / (5 + 5) = 41.5. Over a join from store_sales to store, S1's headcount counts once per sale (3 x 5 + 2 x 5 = 25) and gives 16.6. Summing distinct headcounts counts the shared value 5 once and gives 83. Appendix B.6.
